alignments.note: בְּטֶרֶם rendered by the single Before (rule 30), headed on the adverb carrying the lexeme.
Verb with its supplied modal can.
Supplied the belongs to the noun (rule 15).

First of the correlative כְּמוֹ ... כְּמוֹ ('as well ... as'); the ASV renders the correlation by the postposed alike, which belongs to this particle. Margin (Wrath shall take them away while living as with a whirlwind) read and set aside.
Substantival adjective 'living' rendered the green with its supplied the (rule 46).
Second correlative כְּמוֹ stands where the ASV's connective stands and takes the and (rule 26's reasoning for a member without a waw).
Noun 'burning heat' rendered the burning with supplied the.

שָׂעַר 'sweep away as in a storm' rendered by the whole phrase will take ... away with a whirlwind; the verb's lexeme is carried by whirlwind, so the unit heads there under rule 44's light-verb subtraction; take was the competing head. Discontinuous around the object suffix.

review_notes: The correlative כְּמוֹ pair is rendered and ... alike; each particle takes the word the ASV spent on it.
